infoTitle.title: CEO Message
infoTitle.description:
One Step Co., Ltd. is a bridge connecting international talent with Japanese companies.
Through language education and life support, we create a future where foreigners can work and live with peace of mind.
infoTitle.highlightText: We wholeheartedly support each person's 'one step'.

message.educationContent:
Came to Japan from Nepal 14 years ago. Graduated from Aichi Bunkyo University after attending Japanese language school and vocational school.
Through work experience at Japanese companies, gained deep understanding of Japanese society, business manners, and culture.
Currently holds Japanese nationality and strives to become a 'bridge connecting Japan and foreigners,' supporting both job seekers and companies.
message.paragraph1:
As a foreigner who came to Japan, I experienced various difficulties including language barriers, cultural differences, and job searching.
Learning Japanese, job hunting, and workplace adaptation—none of these were easy paths, but overcoming each challenge has made me who I am today.
message.paragraph2: That's why I believe I can empathize with and support those who are about to work in Japan more than anyone else, understanding their anxieties and expectations.
message.paragraph3:
For companies as well, there are various concerns and challenges when hiring foreigners, such as lack of understanding about language, culture, and systems.
One Step Co., Ltd.'s mission is to carefully bridge these 'invisible walls' and 'misunderstandings' to realize trustworthy and secure matching.
message.paragraph4:
As someone who has already adapted to Japanese society, I provide not just simple job placement, but also meticulous support for new graduates and first-time workers in Japan,
focusing on 'post-employment retention' and 'long-term success.'
message.closingMessage: We wholeheartedly support each person's 'precious one step'.

infoTitle.title: Personal Information Protection Basic Policy
infoTitle.description: One Step Co., Ltd. pays the utmost attention to the protection of personal information and pledges to be a company that responds to the trust of individuals.
infoTitle.highlightText: Respect for privacy. That is the beginning of trust.

basicPolicy.title: Basic Policy
basicPolicy.content: One Step Co., Ltd. deeply recognizes that personal information constitutes important information that makes up privacy, and believes that all personal information must be handled carefully under the philosophy of respecting individual personality. In order to become a company that is trusted, loved, and that we ourselves can be proud of by all people (hereinafter collectively referred to as "individuals"), including customers and business partners, we have established the following basic policy and strive to protect personal information.

sections.title: 1. Regarding the Purpose of Use of Personal Information
sections.content: When we provide personal information, we will use personal information within the scope of the purpose clearly stated when providing personal information.

sections.title: 2. Regarding Disclosure of Personal Information to Third Parties
sections.content: We will not disclose personal information to any third party except in the following cases:
items: When there is consent from the individual
When we judge it appropriate to respond from our affiliated companies or agencies based on the content of inquiries from individuals

When it is necessary to disclose to business outsourcing companies or partner companies that have signed confidentiality agreements in advance for the implementation of the collection purpose clearly stated to individuals
When it is necessary to disclose personal information to financial institutions for payment settlement for product purchases or paid service usage
When disclosing in a state where individuals cannot be identified (statistical materials, etc.)
When disclosure to third parties is permitted by laws, regulations, guidelines, etc.
sections.additional: When we provide or outsource the processing of personal information we hold to third parties, we will pay sufficient attention to the selection of the recipient or outsourcee, and strive to provide necessary supervision to ensure appropriate and reliable protection measures similar to our handling.

sections.title: 3. Regarding Management of Personal Information
sections.content: We will appropriately manage individuals' personal information and implement preventive measures and safety measures against unauthorized access, loss, destruction, alteration, leakage, etc. of personal information. We will also continue to implement internal education regarding the protection and appropriate handling of personal information.

sections.title: 4. Regarding Inquiries About Personal Information
sections.content: When individuals wish to inquire, correct, add, or delete their personal information, we will respond promptly based on our prescribed procedures.

sections.title: 5. Regarding Compliance with Laws and Regulations and Review
sections.content: We will comply with applicable laws and regulations regarding personal information and strive for continuous improvement and enhancement of our personal information protection initiatives.

infoTitle.title: Our Team
infoTitle.highlightText: We are a team composed of foreign members, but we have lived in Japan for many years and deeply understand and respect Japanese culture and values through daily life and work. Some members have even acquired Japanese nationality, and we value contribution to and harmony with Japanese society. One Step Co., Ltd. is not simply a 'company by foreigners,' but wants to be a trusted presence for Japanese companies as a 'partner that understands Japan and grows together with Japan.'

members.aboutJp: I am from Nepal and currently enrolled in a doctoral program at Hokkaido University in Japan, conducting research on wildlife conservation and carnivore ecology. For over 10 years, I have been engaged in field research, international collaborative research, and academic exchange, and I apply the global perspective gained from these experiences to human resource development and cross-cultural collaboration. As Co-founder & Global Collaboration Director of One Step Co., Ltd., I serve as a bridge between excellent overseas talent and reliable domestic companies in Japan. Our mission is not simply to introduce human resources, but to build 'connections of trust and growth' that transcend borders and cultures.

I came to Japan 14 years ago and graduated from Aichi Bunkyo University after attending Japanese language school and vocational school. After that, I got a job at a company and through deep contact with Japanese society and culture, my attachment to Japan grew stronger, and I eventually acquired Japanese nationality. Since 2023, I started my own business, and through my experience in corporate employment and entrepreneurship, I felt firsthand the challenges of 'labor shortage' and 'difficulty for foreigners to find jobs.' With the desire to become a 'bridge' for such challenges, I established 'One Step Co., Ltd.' I speak four languages: Japanese, Nepali, English, and Hindi, providing global support that connects diverse talent with companies.
